_doc: slide-builder skill settings. Read by build_deck.py at startup. Per-build CLI flags override these. Edit + save; takes effect on next invocation. Pattern B documented in _decisions/pattern-b/README.md.
_doc_default_pattern: One of: legacy | auto | B | C. 'legacy' = pre-Pattern-B pipeline verbatim (the safe shipped default). 'auto' = per-slide routing via _classify_all_slides. 'B' = force all slides Pattern B. 'C' = force all slides Pattern C (native, no HTML stage). Per-build override: build_deck.py --pattern <value>.
_doc_enable_pattern_b: Master switch. When false, default_pattern is forced to 'legacy' regardless of its value, and --pattern auto|B is rejected. Flip to true after Pattern B validation lands.
_doc_html_render_canvas: Locked per Decision 1. Do not change without re-validating geometry across all locked specs.
_doc_ssim_thresholds: Per Decision 5 + Spec 5 §3. Critical < 0.70 halts the build; Major < 0.85 surfaces in REVIEW.html; Pass >= 0.90 ships clean.
_doc_translator_timeout_seconds: Per-slide timeout for the slide-builder-translator agent dispatch. Exceeded → translator subprocess killed and slide marked as TRANSLATOR_BLOCKED.
